brief:
The Palestinian Petroleum Authority announced Monday that four tanker trucks carrying cooking gas have entered the Gaza Strip, Shehab Wire reported. The delivery represents a fuel shipment to the territory amid ongoing supply constraints in the coastal enclave.

The authority did not immediately disclose additional details about the consignment, including its origin, the volume transported, or how the gas would be distributed among residents and institutions across Gaza. Cooking gas supplies have faced persistent shortages in the territory in recent months.
